attributes.subject: Q4 Project Update: Milestone Achievements & Next Steps
attributes.body:
Hi Team,

I wanted to share an update on our Q4 progress and outline our priorities for the upcoming quarter.

Key Achievements:
• Launched v2.0 of the mobile app with 98% crash-free sessions
• Reduced API latency by 40% through caching optimizations
• Onboarded 3 new enterprise clients (combined ARR: $2.4M)
• Completed SOC 2 Type II certification

Challenges Faced:
• Integration delays with the payment provider pushed the subscription feature to Q1
• Two key engineers left for other opportunities, requiring rapid backfills

Q1 Priorities:
1. Complete subscription billing integration (target: Feb 15)
2. Launch self-service onboarding for SMB customers
3. Implement real-time collaboration features
4. Reduce time-to-first-value from 7 days to 2 days

I'll be scheduling 1:1s with each team lead to discuss resource allocation. Please come prepared with your capacity estimates.

Let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Best,
Sarah
